privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: LinkClean collects no data. It has no accounts and no servers, and uses no third-party analytics, advertising or crash-reporting tools.
privacy.p2: Rule updates: the app contacts the rules website automatically at most once a day, or when you tap "Update rules now", to download tracking-parameter rules.
privacy.p3: Short-link expansion: when a link you clean is an allow-listed short or share link (for example Facebook, Threads, bit.ly), the app contacts that service directly from your phone to find the original URL. It sends a HEAD request first and falls back to GET only if the service does not support HEAD (page content is then downloaded but never parsed or executed). Further redirects are chosen by that service. You can turn this off in Settings.
privacy.p4: History is kept only in the app's local storage and is never sent to any server by the app. Android system backup is disabled; on iOS it may be included, like other app data, in your own iCloud or computer backups. History can be turned off and cleared at any time.
privacy.p5: The clipboard is used only when you tap Paste or Copy, or when automatic copying of clean links is on.
